issues.concern: The English translation 'There are many beautiful people' misrepresents the Japanese '美人な人がたくさんいる'. '美人' specifically refers to women.
The English translation 'Beauty fades after three days' misrepresents the Japanese proverb '美人は三日で飽きる'. The proverb specifically refers to a beautiful woman, not beauty in general.
issues.suggestion: A beautiful woman will bore you in three days.
